title: The Karnataka Land Revenue (Second Amendment) Bill, 2024
summary: 'The Karnataka Land Revenue (Second Amendment) Bill, 2024' (Bill No. 35 of 2024) is a State legislative measure introduced in the Karnataka Legislative Assembly (Vidhan Sabha) concerning Other / Unclassified. The bill introduces statutory amendments to existing state legislation, primarily modifying Whereas it is expedient further to amend the Karnataka Land Revenue Act; In the Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964; In the Principal Act across 9 identified sections/clauses.
